decisions.reason: The large bulk container is a core product, launched only in 2024 and featured on its own web page, so the firm has invested heavily and committed publicly, and any weak early results can still be put down to ramp-up.
The valve is a dedicated product tied closely to the firm's bulk-container line, with sunk tooling and visible commitment through its own web page, which makes dropping it after one year unlikely.

The take-back service is only mentioned on the website, so the public commitment is smaller, but it supports the firm's announced sustainability and circular-economy direction, so management would likely persist with it.
